açafrão

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Aramaic צפרder.
Arabic زَعْفَرَان (zaʕfarān)
Andalusian Arabic زعفرانbor.
Portuguese açafrão

    Borrowed from Arabic زَعْفَرَان (zaʕfarān, “saffron”),[1][2] via Andalusian Arabic. Cognate with Asturian and Spanish azafrán.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /a.saˈfɾɐ̃w̃/ [a.saˈfɾɐ̃ʊ̯̃]
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.sɐˈfɾɐ̃w̃/

    • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
    • Hyphenation: a‧ça‧frão

    Noun

    [edit]

    açafrão m (plural açafrões)

    1. saffron
